CONAPESCA sport-fishing permits ↗

How it is fished.

Fly or light-tackle sight fishing.

The documented format uses fly or light-tackle sight fishing from a flats skiff, often within a lodge stay. Ask how the guide prioritizes permit against the other targets and whether any wading is planned. March–June is a cited local guide’s peak assessment, not an assurance that all three species will cooperate.

Planning format: Full day or multi-day; flats skiff and lodge. Confirm the actual duration with the provider.

EDITORIAL PREPARATION ADVICE

What to bring.

  • Polarized glasses and sun coverage for long periods of sight fishing.
  • Footwear matched to skiff use or confirmed wading.
  • A compact fly or lure selection based on the lodge’s current requirements.

Before you go.

Does a “Grand Slam” lodge name define my catch objective?

No. Confirm the actual species and itinerary. This page uses bonefish, permit, and tarpon, but a business name alone does not establish what a trip includes.

What seasonal window does the evidence support?

March to June is the cited local guide's peak window. A seasonal account does not confirm current availability. Use the linked authority for current rules.
